_comment: Machine-readable twin of research/README.md: the quarterly sectors, their PubMed searches and when each was last reviewed. `healthgo pubmed` pulls everything added to PubMed since `last_reviewed`; /knowledge-review moves the date forward once a sector is done. Each query is PubMed syntax; the study-type filter (meta-analysis, systematic review, RCT) is added by the code.
